items.title: Mandelbrot Set Boundary Glyphs
items.basis: The Mandelbrot set is generated by iterating the function $f_c(z) = z^2 + c$. The boundary between points that escape to infinity and those that remain bounded is fractal. Zooming into this boundary reveals intricate, self-similar structures.
items.prompt:
Create a Daddy Dingy dingbat contact sheet. Nine distinct black-on-white glyphs, arranged in an invisible 3x3 grid with generous spacing. The theme is the boundary of the Mandelbrot set. Include glyphs showing: 1. A classic 'seahorse valley' region with detailed filigree. 2. A tight spiral formation resembling a nautilus shell. 3. An abstract, spiky form representing a high-iteration escape zone. 4. A delicate, branching structure reminiscent of frost crystals. 5. A tightly packed cluster of mini-Mandelbrots. 6. A region with 'M' or 'W' shaped islands. 7. A chaotic, wispy boundary edge. 8. A region exhibiting strong period-doubling cascades. 9. A smooth, almost circular section transitioning to extreme complexity. Ensure all glyphs have ample white space for extraction. Black on white only.

Every mark must be pure black (#000000); white is negative space, not a second paint color. Arrange the nine in a loose INVISIBLE 3x3. Leave generous, entirely empty white clearance horizontally, vertically AND diagonally between every complete motif, including its outermost dots, drips, stars and flourishes. Each glyph should occupy approximately 65-75% of its imaginary cell in its dominant dimension, not reach the cell edges; no rows, columns or neighbors may visually merge. All nine must have distinct silhouettes/internal organization and recognizable focal structure. Intricate thin linework, stippling, engraving-like texture, black dots, cutouts and elaborate ornaments ARE ALLOWED: composition over simplicity. The request for 'M' or 'W' shaped islands specifically references known emergent structures in the Mandelbrot set's boundary.
